messages:
Ava Turner: quick follow-up from this morning's DR rehearsal. We saw repeated patterns: overlapping route policy changes, incomplete cross-region snapshot copies, and unclear post-restore validation steps. Need owners + short ETAs.
Noah Kim: noted. Routing first: when control-plane reconfigs and DNS TTL swaps overlap we get ~20-40s of service blips. Proposal: add a HOLD step that drains connections and a 90s buffer before TTL swap. I can own and test. ETA: 48h.
Ivy Singh: I'll take snapshots. Found 5/42 snapshots missing cross-region copies due to replication filters excluding `snapshots/`. Plan: update replication rule and add `snap-verify.sh` that outputs CSV and supports `--fix`. ETA: scan tonight, repair tomorrow.
Marc Duval: runbook gaps: missing exact SQL for replica lag and no explicit success signals. I'll update runbook with CHECK_REPLICA SQL, expected lag thresholds, and a short smoke test sequence. Draft by Fri EOD.
Oncall-Bot: Reminder: @Noah Kim your on-call starts in 28 hours.
Ava Turner: great. Noah, please include canary plan and acceptance criteria. Ivy, include a dry-run mode in the verifier. Marc, add expected outputs for each validation step.
Noah Kim: canary plan: run 3 control-plane flaps against `canary-eu-west` with synthetic traffic, measure `failover_convergence_ms` and compare baseline. Will post results here.
Ivy Singh: verifier prototype: `tools/snap-verify.sh --region eu-west --out missing.csv --fix` will produce CSV and suggested copy jobs in dry-run.
Marc Duval: runbook checklist I'll add: pre-checks, DNS cutover step-by-step with timing math, CHECK_REPLICA SQL + sample output, and rollback criteria.
Ava Turner: I'll create a Jira epic to track these and link PRs. ETA for epic: EOD today.
Oncall-Bot: Jira EPIC RINF-2799 created: "DR rehearsal: routing, snapshots, runbook" by Ava Turner.
Noah Kim: need access to `canary-eu-west`. @Ava Turner can you grant?
Ava Turner: granted. Noah has `canary-eu-west` access.
Ivy Singh: PR draft for verifier: https://git.redwood/infra/snap-tools/pull/504 (dry-run mode included).
Marc Duval: runbook PR: https://git.redwood/playbooks/dr-restore/pull/139 (includes CHECK_REPLICA examples and smoke tests).
Ava Turner: owners recap and timelines: Noah = routing + canary (48h), Ivy = snapshot verifier & repair (24-48h), Marc = runbook updates (Fri EOD), Ava = tracking & Jira epic. Weekly check-ins until closed. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
